step_by_step_reasoning:
1. Identify all 9 active AWS component nodes from the visual diagram and audio transcript: S3 (vendor catalog storage), Step Functions (pipeline orchestration), SageMaker (custom NER ML models), DynamoDB (structured attribute store), OpenSearch/Elasticsearch (search engine), Neptune (knowledge graph), API Gateway (entry point for UI), Lambda (backend logic and pipeline execution), and Kinesis (clickstream data capture).
2. Establish flow 0 for catalog processing: Step Functions triggers/reads unstructured data from S3, SageMaker processes catalogs and interacts with S3/Step Functions, and Step Functions saves converted structured attribute data into DynamoDB via Lambda.
3. Establish flow 1 for stream sync: DynamoDB Streams triggers Lambda functions to push data updates to OpenSearch for search indexing and Neptune for knowledge graph triplets.
4. Establish flow 2 for search & recommendation retrieval: API Gateway receives requests from the web UI and invokes Lambda, which queries OpenSearch for free-text search, DynamoDB for product attributes, and Neptune for graph recommendations.
5. Establish flow 3 for real-time user feedback: Kinesis captures user navigation events and forwards them to Lambda to update interaction patterns in the database ecosystem.

graph.name: Novartis Buying Engine Architecture
graph.categories: Healthcare & Life Sciences, ML & AI, E-Commerce
graph.notes: Architecture for Novartis Buying Engine, an internal procurement portal that uses ML pipelines (SageMaker, Step Functions) and multi-database indexing (DynamoDB, Elasticsearch, Neptune) for search and recommendations.

nodes.name: STEP FUNCTIONS
nodes.notes: Orchestrates machine learning pipelines for catalog structuring.

nodes.name: SAGEMAKER
nodes.notes: Runs custom Named Entity Recognition (NER) models to extract product attributes.

nodes.name: ELASTICSEARCH
nodes.notes: Acts as the search engine for free-text queries on the portal.

nodes.name: DYNAMODB
nodes.notes: Primary database storing structured product attribute data.

nodes.name: NEPTUNE
nodes.notes: Graph database storing triplets for product recommendations.

nodes.name: API GW
nodes.notes: API gateway interfacing the custom frontend shopping portal with backend Lambda functions.

nodes.name: LAMBDA
nodes.notes: Executes backend logic for search, product lookup, recommendations, and stream processing.

nodes.name: KINESIS
nodes.notes: Captures real-time anonymized user clickstream and navigation interaction data.

edges.notes: Step Functions reads unstructured vendor catalogs stored in S3.
SageMaker processes vendor catalogs stored in S3 using custom NER pipelines.
SageMaker pipeline status and output events managed via Step Functions and Lambda.
Step Functions writes converted structured product attribute data into DynamoDB via Lambda.
DynamoDB Streams triggers Lambda to sync structured product updates into Elasticsearch.
DynamoDB Streams triggers Lambda to create/update product triplets in Neptune.
API Gateway receives frontend user interactions and invokes Lambda.
Lambda queries Elasticsearch for user free-text searches.
Lambda fetches product attribute details from DynamoDB.
Lambda fetches product recommendations and complementary items from Neptune.
Kinesis streams anonymized user navigation events into Lambda to continuously update recommendations.
